ASO Review — Before and After the Polish Pass

9 Oct 2026 · the prototype at 1440×900, the same demo file (JAIPUR/04900). Nothing in the data or the workflow changed.

The header

The status sat alone at the far right; now it reads beside the NGO name, with the project and reference grouped beneath. More space between the file and the decision panel.

Documents — the rows

Titles were cut to one line (“List of Managing Committe…”); now they wrap to two lines and every file name shows in full.

The decision panel

The blockers were said twice — as the checklist and again as a five-part sentence under Forward. Now the checklist carries them (including a document awaiting an overrule reason), Forward says only “Available once every step … is done”, and the note on Raise Deficiency sits under the buttons it explains.

At phone width

No sideways scroll at 390px; the status badge wraps under the name.
